text.p: Tropical cyclone Gretelle is now moving away from the South Africa coast. The system is becoming less of a risk to shipping as it continues to weaken. Top winds are now only 40 mph. The will accelerate to the southeast and become extratropical by 12 hours.

Tropical Cyclone Pancho-Helinda will threaten shipping over the open Indian Ocean. The storm has 60-65 mph top winds and is near 16s/87e, moving west-southwestward. Pancho-Helinda should strengthen some this weekend. It is only a risk to shipping at this time.
Tropical cyclone Freda as reformed near the dateline at 29s. This system will only threaten shipping as it moves west-southwest this weekend. It should weaken and dissipate again later in the period.
